# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: USA gulf effects — scripted effects.
## COLDWAR | Iraq 1970. Generated by tools/iraq_1970/compile.py.

COLDWAR_USA_gulf_quote_accord = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_paid }
			NOT = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_invoice > 0 }
			}
			check_variable = { gdp_total > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_invoice = gdp_total }
		multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_invoice = .02 }
	}
}
COLDWAR_USA_gulf_withdraw_air = {
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_northern_air_readiness
	KUR = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_KUR_coalition_air_cover }
	PUK = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_KUR_coalition_air_cover }
}
COLDWAR_USA_gulf_start_air = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = USA
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
			NOT = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_current_settlement_policy = 1 }
			}
			OR = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_current_settlement_policy = 2 }
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_external_policy_active = yes
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = {
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_current_settlement_policy = 2 }
					}
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_humanitarian_crisis = yes
				}
			}
		}
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_northern_air_readiness
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_northern_air_readiness days = 90 }
		KUR = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_air_offer days = 14 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.20 }
			}
		}
		PUK = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes }
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_air_offer days = 14 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.20 }
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_fresh_north_consent }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_fresh_north_consent
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_USA_gulf_initial_underground = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = USA
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_northern_grievance = yes
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_eligible_north = yes
			NOT = {
				KUR = { exists = yes }
			}
			NOT = {
				PUK = { exists = yes }
			}
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_initial_package_used }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.25 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			has_equipment = { infantry_weapons_1 > 999 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.25 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_weapons_1 amount = -1000 }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_initial_package_used
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_cache = 1000 }
		COLDWAR_USA_gulf_seed_north = yes
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_days = 90 }
		COLDWAR_USA_gulf_refresh_targets = yes
		TUR = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.40 }
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_USA_gulf_deliver_cache = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_cache_acceptance
			USA = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_cache > 0 }
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
			}
		}
		add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_weapons_1 amount = USA.COLDWAR_USA_gulf_cache }
		USA = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_cache = 0 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_cache_delivered
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_cache_received
		if = {
			limit = {
				USA = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_days > 0 }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_kur }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_puk }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { tag = KUR }
				USA = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_kur }
			}
			else = {
				USA = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_puk }
			}
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_KUR_us_advisers
			164 = { remove_resistance_target = 19709101 }
			633 = { remove_resistance_target = 19709101 }
			630 = { remove_resistance_target = 19709101 }
			1078 = { remove_resistance_target = 19709101 }
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_USA_gulf_start_security = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_invoice = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_invoice = 0.02 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = IRQ
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_insurgency = yes
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_force_present = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_cooldown }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_small
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_major
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_small days = 90 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_cooldown days = 90 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_delivery days = 90 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_age = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_reduction = 15 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_target = -20 }
	}
}
COLDWAR_USA_gulf_start_major_operation = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_invoice = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_invoice = 0.04 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = IRQ
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_insurgency = yes
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_force_present = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_cooldown }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_invoice compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_invoice }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_small
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_major
		add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_major days = 90 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_cooldown days = 90 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_delivery days = 90 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_age = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_reduction = 25 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_target = -35 }
	}
}
COLDWAR_USA_gulf_end_security = {
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_small
	remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_major
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_delivery
	164 = { remove_resistance_target = 19709102 }
	633 = { remove_resistance_target = 19709102 }
	630 = { remove_resistance_target = 19709102 }
	1078 = { remove_resistance_target = 19709102 }
}
COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_reduce = {
	164 = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ has_resistance = yes occupied_country_tag = KUR }
			add_resistance = -15
			if = {
				limit = {
					IRQ = { has_idea = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_major }
				}
				add_resistance = -10
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19709102
			add_resistance_target = {
				id = 19709102
				amount = IRQ.COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_target
				occupier = IRQ
				occupied = KUR
				days = 60
				tooltip = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_target_security
			}
		}
	}
	633 = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ has_resistance = yes occupied_country_tag = KUR }
			add_resistance = -15
			if = {
				limit = {
					IRQ = { has_idea = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_major }

				add_resistance = -10
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19709102
			add_resistance_target = {
				id = 19709102
				amount = IRQ.COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_target
				occupier = IRQ
				occupied = KUR
				days = 60
				tooltip = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_target_security
			}
		}
	}
	630 = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = IRQ has_resistance = yes occupied_country_tag = KUR }
			add_resistance = -15
			if = {
				limit = {
					IRQ = { has_idea = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_major }
				}
				add_resistance = -10
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19709102
			add_resistance_target = {

				amount = IRQ.COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_target
				occupier = IRQ
				occupied = KUR
				days = 60

			add_resistance = -15
			if = {
				limit = {

COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognize_kurdish_autonomy = {
	if = {
		limit = { tag = IRQ has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_accepted has_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_autonomy_fulfilled }
		KUR = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_consent
					NOT = { is_subject = yes }
				}
				IRQ = {
					set_autonomy = { target = KUR autonomy_state = COLDWAR_IRQ_kurdish_autonomy freedom_level = 0.8 end_wars = yes end_civil_wars = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		PUK = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_consent
					NOT = { is_subject = yes }
				}
				IRQ = {
					set_autonomy = { target = PUK autonomy_state = COLDWAR_IRQ_kurdish_autonomy freedom_level = 0.8 end_wars = yes end_civil_wars = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_respected = yes }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_IRQ_federal_settlement
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_resolve_grievance = yes
		}
	}
}

			cancel_resistance = yes

		}
	}

		}

COLDWAR_USA_gulf_bounded_uprising = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = IRQ
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_uprising_fired }
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_northern_grievance = yes
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_military_opening = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_uprising_fired
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_uprising_warning
		164 = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_seeded
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_eligible_164 = yes
					resistance > 79
					occupied_country_tag = KUR
				}
				set_state_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_rebel_stronghold
				remove_resistance_target = 19709101
				remove_resistance_target = 19709102
				KUR = { transfer_state = 164 }
				set_resistance = 0
			}
		}
		633 = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_seeded
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_eligible_633 = yes
					resistance > 79
					occupied_country_tag = KUR
				}
				set_state_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_rebel_stronghold
				remove_resistance_target = 19709101
				remove_resistance_target = 19709102
				KUR = { transfer_state = 633 }
				set_resistance = 0
			}
		}
		630 = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_seeded
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_eligible_630 = yes
					resistance > 79
					occupied_country_tag = KUR
				}

				set_resistance = 0

				}

				remove_resistance_target = 19709102
				PUK = { transfer_state = 1078 }
				set_resistance = 0
			}
		}
		KUR = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes
					NOT = { is_subject_of = IRQ }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_columns_created }
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_columns_created
					division_template = {
						name = "COLDWAR Kurdish Local Column"
						is_locked = yes
						regiments = {
							Militia_Bat = { x = 0 y = 0 }
							Militia_Bat = { x = 0 y = 1 }
						}
					}
					random_owned_controlled_state = {
						limit = {
							OR = { state = 164 state = 633 state = 630 state = 1078 }
						}
						create_unit = {
							division = "division_template = \"COLDWAR Kurdish Local Column\" start_experience_factor = 0.2 start_equipment_factor = 0"
							owner = KUR
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_war_with = IRQ }
					}
					declare_war_on = { target = IRQ type = annex_everything }
				}
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_cache_offer days = 30 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.23 }
			}
		}
		PUK = {

					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes
					NOT = { is_subject_of = IRQ }

COLDWAR_USA_gulf_usa_daily = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_policy_offer
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_offer_to = 1 }
		}
		COLDWAR_USA_gulf_commit_recognised_policy = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_policy_offer
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_offer_to = 2 }
		}
		COLDWAR_USA_gulf_commit_external_policy = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_current_settlement_policy = 1 }
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_days > 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_respected = yes
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.0035714285714285718 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.0035714285714285718 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_days = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_days = 0 }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_USA_gulf_reconcile_settlement_policy = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_external_policy_active = yes
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protected_war = yes
			NOT = { has_war_with = IRQ }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_challenge }
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_challenge days = 90 }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.43 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_kuwait_unresolved = yes }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_kuwait_crisis_recorded
	}
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_respected = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_days > 0 }
			}
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_stop_support = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_days > 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_northern_grievance = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.0071428571428571435 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_kur }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_puk }
					}
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_kur
						KUR = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes }
					}
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_puk
						PUK = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.0071428571428571435 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_days = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_kur }
				KUR = {
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 0.0071428571428571435 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_puk }
				PUK = {
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 0.0071428571428571435 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_advance_expansion = yes
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_refresh_targets = yes
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_pulse_age = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_pulse_age > 29 }
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_pulse_age = 0 }
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_active = yes }
						}
						164 = {
							if = {
								limit = {
									has_state_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_seeded
									COLDWAR_USA_gulf_eligible_164 = yes
									occupied_country_tag = KUR
									resistance < 80
								}
								if = {
									limit = { resistance > 70 }
									set_resistance = 80
								}
								else = { add_resistance = 10 }
							}
						}
						633 = {
							if = {
								limit = {
									has_state_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_seeded
									COLDWAR_USA_gulf_eligible_633 = yes
									occupied_country_tag = KUR
									resistance < 80
								}
								if = {
									limit = { resistance > 70 }
									set_resistance = 80
								}
								else = { add_resistance = 10 }
							}
						}
						630 = {
							if = {
								limit = {
									has_state_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_seeded
									COLDWAR_USA_gulf_eligible_630 = yes
									occupied_country_tag = KUR
									resistance < 80
								}
								if = {
									limit = { resistance > 70 }
									set_resistance = 80
								}
								else = { add_resistance = 10 }
							}
						}
						1078 = {
							if = {
								limit = {
									has_state_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_seeded
									COLDWAR_USA_gulf_eligible_1078 = yes
									occupied_country_tag = PUK
									resistance < 80
								}
								if = {
									limit = { resistance > 70 }
									set_resistance = 80
								}
								else = { add_resistance = 10 }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_support_days < 1 }
				}
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_stop_support = yes
			}
		}
		else = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_stop_support = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_relief_days > 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_humanitarian_crisis = yes
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_programme_limited_war
						NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
						check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.002857142857142857 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
					AND = {
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_programme_limited_war }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
						check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.0035714285714285718 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_programme_limited_war }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.002857142857142857 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.0035714285714285718 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_relief_days = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_relief_days = 0 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_days > 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
				OR = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_current_settlement_policy = 2 }
						COLDWAR_USA_gulf_external_policy_active = yes
					}
					AND = {
						NOT = {
							check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_current_settlement_policy = 2 }
						}
						COLDWAR_USA_gulf_humanitarian_crisis = yes
					}
				}
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.0071428571428571435 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.0071428571428571435 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_days = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_days = 0 }
		}
	}
	164 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				USA = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_relief_days > 0 }
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
				}
				OR = {
					is_controlled_by = USA
					is_controlled_by = KUR
					is_controlled_by = PUK
					AND = { is_controlled_by = IRQ COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_respected = yes }
				}
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_relief_local days = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				USA = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_days > 0 }
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
				}
				OR = { is_controlled_by = USA is_controlled_by = KUR is_controlled_by = PUK }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_local days = 2 }
		}
	}
	633 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				USA = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_relief_days > 0 }
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
				}
				OR = {
					is_controlled_by = USA
					is_controlled_by = KUR
					is_controlled_by = PUK
					AND = { is_controlled_by = IRQ COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_respected = yes }
				}
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_relief_local days = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				USA = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_days > 0 }
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
				}
				OR = { is_controlled_by = USA is_controlled_by = KUR is_controlled_by = PUK }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_local days = 2 }
		}
	}
	630 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				USA = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_relief_days > 0 }
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
				}
				OR = {
					is_controlled_by = USA
					is_controlled_by = KUR
					is_controlled_by = PUK
					AND = { is_controlled_by = IRQ COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_respected = yes }
				}
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_relief_local days = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				USA = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_days > 0 }
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
				}
				OR = { is_controlled_by = USA is_controlled_by = KUR is_controlled_by = PUK }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_local days = 2 }
		}
	}
	1078 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				USA = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_relief_days > 0 }
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
				}
				OR = {
					is_controlled_by = USA
					is_controlled_by = KUR
					is_controlled_by = PUK
					AND = { is_controlled_by = IRQ COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_respected = yes }
				}
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_relief_local days = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				USA = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_days > 0 }
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
				}
				OR = { is_controlled_by = USA is_controlled_by = KUR is_controlled_by = PUK }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_local days = 2 }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_USA_gulf_reconcile_settlement_policy = yes
}
COLDWAR_USA_gulf_irq_daily = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_quote = gdp_total }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_quote = .02 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_major_quote = gdp_total }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_major_quote = .04 }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_active = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_delivery }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_force_present = yes }
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_age = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_age = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_age > 29 }
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_force_present = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_reduce = yes
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_delivery
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_security_active = yes }
		}
		164 = { remove_resistance_target = 19709102 }
		633 = { remove_resistance_target = 19709102 }
		630 = { remove_resistance_target = 19709102 }
		1078 = { remove_resistance_target = 19709102 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_respected = yes }
		COLDWAR_USA_gulf_resolve_grievance = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_uprising_fired }
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_northern_campaign_tracked
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_hot_states = 0 }
		164 = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_seeded
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_eligible_164 = yes
					occupied_country_tag = KUR
					resistance > 79
				}
				IRQ = {
					add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_hot_states = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		633 = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_seeded
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_eligible_633 = yes
					occupied_country_tag = KUR
					resistance > 79
				}
				IRQ = {
					add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_hot_states = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		630 = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_seeded
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_eligible_630 = yes
					occupied_country_tag = KUR
					resistance > 79
				}
				IRQ = {
					add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_hot_states = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		1078 = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_seeded
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_eligible_1078 = yes
					occupied_country_tag = PUK
					resistance > 79
				}
				IRQ = {
					add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_hot_states = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_hot_states > 1 }
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_military_opening = yes
				USA = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_cache > 0 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_below_days = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_uprising_warning }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_warning_days = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_warning_days > 44 }
					}
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_bounded_uprising = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_qualifying_days = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_qualifying_days > 29 }
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_uprising_warning
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_warning_days = 0 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.41 }
					USA = {
						country_event = { id = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.41 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_uprising_warning }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_qualifying_days = 0 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_below_days = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_below_days > 14 }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_qualifying_days = 0 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_warning_days = 0 }
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_uprising_warning
			}
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_USA_gulf_clear_settlement_benefits = {
	IRQ = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognised_budget }
	KUR = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognised_development remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_external_guarantee }
	PUK = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognised_development remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_external_guarantee }
}
COLDWAR_USA_gulf_reconcile_settlement_policy = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognised_policy_active = yes }
		IRQ = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognised_budget }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognised_budget
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		IRQ = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognised_budget }
	}
	KUR = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognised_policy_active = yes
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_consent
				is_subject_of = IRQ
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognised_development }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognised_development
			}
		}
		else = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognised_development }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_external_policy_active = yes COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protected_actor = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_external_guarantee }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_external_guarantee
			}
		}
		else = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_external_guarantee }
	}
	PUK = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognised_policy_active = yes
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_consent
				is_subject_of = IRQ
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognised_development }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognised_development
			}
		}
		else = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_recognised_development }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_external_policy_active = yes COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protected_actor = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_external_guarantee }
				}
				add_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_external_guarantee
			}
		}
		else = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_external_guarantee }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			USA = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_current_settlement_policy = 2 }
				NOT = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_external_policy_active = yes }
			}
		}
		USA = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_days = 0 }
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_withdraw_air = yes
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_USA_gulf_withdraw_settlement_policy = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_current_settlement_policy = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_days = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_days = 0 }
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_policy_offer
	COLDWAR_USA_gulf_withdraw_air = yes
	COLDWAR_USA_gulf_clear_settlement_benefits = yes
}
COLDWAR_USA_gulf_commit_recognised_policy = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_policy_funding_floor = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_revision_fee }
	add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_policy_funding_floor = 0.0035714285714285718 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_can_commit_settlement_policy = yes
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_offer_to = 1 }
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_respected = yes
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_policy_funding_floor compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_revision_fee }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		COLDWAR_USA_gulf_clear_settlement_benefits = yes
		COLDWAR_USA_gulf_withdraw_air = yes
		COLDWAR_USA_gulf_stop_support = yes
		KUR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_consent clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_offer }
		PUK = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_consent clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_offer }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_days = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_days = 90 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_current_settlement_policy = 1 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_last_settlement_policy = 1 }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_policy_offer
		COLDWAR_USA_gulf_reconcile_settlement_policy = yes
	}
}
COLDWAR_USA_gulf_commit_external_policy = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_policy_funding_floor = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_revision_fee }
	add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_policy_funding_floor = 0.0071428571428571435 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_can_commit_settlement_policy = yes
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_offer_to = 2 }
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_northern_grievance = yes
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
			OR = {
				KUR = {
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes
					NOT = { is_subject_of = IRQ }
				}
				PUK = {
					COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes
					NOT = { is_subject_of = IRQ }
				}
			}
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					KUR = {
						COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes
						NOT = { is_subject_of = IRQ }
					}
				}
				KUR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_consent }
			}
			OR = {
				NOT = {
					PUK = {
						COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes
						NOT = { is_subject_of = IRQ }
					}
				}
				PUK = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_consent }
			}
			any_country = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_fresh_host = yes }
			has_deployed_air_force_size = { size > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_policy_funding_floor compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_revision_fee }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		COLDWAR_USA_gulf_clear_settlement_benefits = yes
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_accord_days = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_current_settlement_policy = 2 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_last_settlement_policy = 2 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_days = 90 }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_policy_offer
		COLDWAR_USA_gulf_start_air = yes
		COLDWAR_USA_gulf_reconcile_settlement_policy = yes
		IRQ = {
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.54 }
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_USA_gulf_request_accord_policy = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = USA
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_campaign = yes
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_policy_offer }
			IRQ = { exists = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_current_settlement_policy }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_current_settlement_policy = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_last_settlement_policy }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_last_settlement_policy = 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_revision_fee = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_last_settlement_policy > 0 }
				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_last_settlement_policy = 1 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_revision_fee = .25 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_revision_fee compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_offer_from = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_current_settlement_policy }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_offer_to = 1 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_policy_offer days = 90 }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_respected = yes }
				COLDWAR_USA_gulf_commit_recognised_policy = yes
			}
			else = {
				IRQ = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							OR = {
								KUR = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes }
								PUK = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes }
							}
						}
						COLDWAR_USA_gulf_quote_accord = yes
						country_event = { id = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.30 }
					}
					else = { COLDWAR_IRQ_begin_kurdish_negotiations = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = {

			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_route_open = yes

				NOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_last_settlement_policy = 2 }
				}
			}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }

			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_offer_from = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_current_settlement_policy }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_USA_gulf_settlement_offer_to = 2 }

			KUR = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_consent
				if = {

						NOT = { is_subject_of = IRQ }
					}
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_offer days = 30 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.52 }
				}
			}
			PUK = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_consent
				if = {
					limit = {
						COLDWAR_USA_gulf_local_actor = yes
						NOT = { is_subject_of = IRQ }
					}
					set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_offer days = 30 }
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_events.52 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_USA_gulf_escalate_protection = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = USA
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_external_policy_active = yes
			COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protected_war = yes
			NOT = { has_war_with = IRQ }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_escalation_used }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MD_skip_treasury_cost }
			check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.5 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.5 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_USA_gulf_protection_escalation_used
		create_wargoal = { type = liberate_wargoal target = IRQ expire = 60 }
	}
}
